components.name: Skill Contract
components.purpose: Define normative governance, acceptance, documentation, and handoff behavior.

components.name: Project Truth Compiler
components.purpose: Project machine-readable facts and semantic specs into deterministic human-facing Markdown.

components.name: Source & Sequence Extractors
components.purpose: Observe machine-verifiable source structure through normalized language adapters, preserve accepted Python and JS/TS evidence, and keep unsupported or dynamic behavior NOT_PROVEN.

components.name: Governance Validators
components.purpose: Fail closed on stale docs, broken references, sequence drift, truth inconsistencies, and handoff defects.

components.name: Initializer & Templates
components.purpose: Install project-local governance specs and tool support into consumer repositories.

components.name: GitHub Actions Acceptance
components.purpose: Execute cross-platform self-tests and exact-candidate governance validation.

components.name: Machine-Readable Project Truth
components.purpose: Hold semantic intent, current state, roadmap, claims, contracts, and acceptance declarations.

data_flows.meaning: Current source is scanned into machine-observable facts and digests.
Declared semantics and state are projected with observed source facts.
Canonical deterministic human-facing Markdown is generated.
Validators evaluate required truth gates without upgrading unproven evidence.
Exact candidate acceptance is exposed as blocking CI evidence.

external_boundaries.contract: Source hosting, pull requests, Actions execution, branch/ruleset enforcement, and release provenance.
external_boundaries.name: GitHub

external_boundaries.contract: Skill Workflow is vendored/installed into projects that provide project-specific source, tests, runtime evidence, and semantic specs.
external_boundaries.name: Consumer repositories
